title: Senior Systems Engineer (Presales) - Netops
description:
**Solution Architect – Secure Networking – India**

**Location:** Gurgaon / NCR
  

**Department:** SME Engineering – Secure Networking  



**About Fortinet**

Fortinet has been founded on the principle of converging networking and security into a unified solution. Over the past 12 years, Fortinet has significantly expanded its Wired and Wireless networking portfolio through organic innovation and strategic acquisitions.


This growth has been recognized by Gartner®, which positioned Fortinet as a **Leader in the 2024 and 2025 Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Wired and Wireless LAN Infrastructure** .


If you have **12\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise Wired and Wireless networking solutions** , this is an opportunity to join Fortinet's Subject Matter Expert (SME) team and take your networking expertise into the next level of Network Security.  



**Role Overview**

As a **Solution Architect – Secure Networking** , you will be part of the SME Engineering team supporting the India \& SAARC region.


You will work closely with Account Teams and Field Systems Engineers to position Fortinet's Secure Networking portfolio, including:


* Network Access Control (NAC)
* Wireless
* Enterprise Switching
* Identity \& Access Management (AAA)
* Voice Solutions
* ZTNA
* SD\-Branch

The role involves providing **second\-level pre\-sales technical support** , leading complex customer engagements, conducting POCs and demonstrations, and acting as a technical bridge between the field teams and Fortinet's Consulting Systems Engineering (CSE) organization.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Support**

* Provide second\-level pre\-sales support to the Field SE organization.
* Support RFPs/RFIs with solution design, specifications, and product information.
* Support strategic and complex customer projects to ensure successful Fortinet engagements.
* Lead technical discussions and articulate technology capabilities and differentiated value.
* Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* Provide hands\-on technical assistance during customer engagements.
* Conduct external workshops and POCs for prospects and customers in collaboration with Account SEs.
Perform hands\-on testing to validate network designs, POC environments, and network deployments.  
* 

**Technical Content \& Enablement**

* Develop technical materials to support sales activities, including:
	+ Presentations / slideware
	+ Solution briefs
	+ White papers
	+ Success stories
	+ Technical notes
	+ Competitive comparisons
* Design and conduct internal technical workshops.
Enable and disseminate product knowledge across Sales and Channel teams.  
* 

**SME \& Product Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for the CSE team.
* Consolidate customer requirements and technical feedback across the India region.
* Validate business cases and create/escalate product feature requests.
* Report project activities and analyze project trends.
* Provide market and competitive insights.
* Participate in the development of commercial strategies.
Collect competitive intelligence on networking and security solutions and share insights with Account and Channel teams.  
* 

**Travel**

* Ability to travel across India at short notice, as required.
* Expected to work from the office **four days per week** to facilitate collaboration with extended teams and build strong working relationships.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **12\+ years of experience** in a Senior SE, Consulting SE, or senior technical role within Networking or IT Security.
* Experience working with both **vendors and system integrators (SI)** .
* Strong hands\-on expertise in enterprise networking and security.
* Bachelor's degree in:
	+ Computer Science
	+ Information Technology
	+ Electronics
	+ Computer Applications
	Or equivalent experience in networking/security.  
	+

**Core Technical Expertise**

**Network Access Control (NAC)**

* Strong experience designing, proposing, demonstrating, and conducting POCs for NAC solutions.
* NAC deployment and troubleshooting.
* 802\.1X authentication and device onboarding.
* MAC Address Bypass (MAB).
* LAN micro\-segmentation.
BYOD and IoT onboarding.  
* 

**Wireless**

Deep understanding of enterprise Wireless technologies, including:


* IEEE 802\.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be
* IEEE 802\.11e/h/i/k/r/v
* CAPWAP
* Wireless Controller Architecture
* Campus and remote AP deployments
* Wireless design, site surveys, implementation, and troubleshooting
* WIPS
* Wireless spectrum analysis
* OFDMA
* Spatial Reuse
* UL/DL MU\-MIMO
* BLE / Zigbee
WPA / WPA2 / WPA3  
* 

**Authentication \& AAA**

* RADIUS
* LDAP
* Certificate\-based authentication
* Wired and Wireless authentication
* SAML
* Single Sign\-On (SSO)
* Two\-factor authentication
* EAP\-TLS
* EAP\-TTLS/MSCHAPv2
* PEAP
* EAP\-SIM / EAP\-AKA
EAP\-FAST  
* 

**Enterprise Switching**

Experience designing and proposing **Data Center, Campus, and Branch switching solutions** , including:


* VLAN / IEEE 802\.1Q
* VXLAN
* MLAG / MCLAG
* Stacking
* STP
* ACLs
* QoS
* Port Security
* 802\.1X
* PoE / PoE budget calculations
* LLDP / MED
* RADIUS CoA
* DHCP Snooping
* IGMP
* QinQ
* Private VLAN
* Storm Control
* LoopGuard
* PortFast
* Split Port
Link Aggregation  
* 

**Routing \& Network Fundamentals**

* Strong TCP/IP fundamentals
* IPv6
* Advanced OSPF and BGP
* Multicast
* NAT
* VRF
* IPSec
* SSL/TLS
* Packet capture and network analysis
* VoIP / QoS
LTE / 5G  
* 

**Secure Networking**

* Hands\-on experience with **NGFW / UTM / Threat Prevention**
* Knowledge and ability to pitch:
	+ ZTNA
	+ SD\-Branch
	+ Network Security
	LAN Micro\-segmentation  
	+

**Additional Technical Skills**

Knowledge in the following areas is advantageous:  



**Automation \& Scripting**

* Python
* Bash
* PowerShell
Golang or equivalent  
* 

**Operating Systems**

Linux administration  

* 

**Cloud**

Knowledge of public cloud technologies and concepts across:


* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)  
* 

**Private Cloud**

Knowledge of:


* VMware
KVM  
* 

**Other Technologies**

* MDM solutions
* IoT solutions
* SNMP
* MIB / OIDs
Network monitoring and troubleshooting tools  
* 

**What This Role Primarily Requires**

**Core must\-have areas:**

**NAC \+ Wireless \+ Enterprise Switching \+ AAA/IAM \+ Routing (BGP/OSPF) \+ Hands\-on Networking \+ Pre\-Sales/POCs**

The role is specifically focused on **deep enterprise networking expertise combined with pre\-sales consulting** , rather than general cybersecurity, SD\-WAN, or SASE experience alone.  



**Equal Opportunity**

Fortinet is an equal opportunity employer.


We will only notify shortlisted candidates.


Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes.


Please refrain from sending unsolicited resumes to Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases.
